name: Container hardening
arch: Grad project Dockerfile rewritten from memory: multi-stage, non-root, healthcheck, pinned base.
steps: Fix or justify top findings in the README
goal: Minimal attack surface in what you ship.
value: Shows you can harden, not only containerize.

name: CI with security gates
arch: GitHub Actions on push: tests, pip-audit, Bandit, gitleaks, Trivy; fail on high; SBOM added later (DSO-2).
steps: Tests in CI with Postgres/Redis service containers
Plant a vulnerable dependency and a fake secret; show both blocked
deliv: One red and one green run; README explains each gate's trade-off.
value: The DevSecOps job description in one repo.

name: AWS deployment
arch: VPC with public/private subnets; app on EC2 or ECS; Postgres private; least-privilege security groups; secrets in SSM/Secrets Manager; budget alarm; documented teardown.
goal: Private data tier, no long-lived keys, controlled cost.
deliv: Running app + architecture diagram + teardown doc.
value: Matches the AWS skills most Egyptian DevOps postings name.

name: Terraform + policy as code
arch: PS-3 environment fully in Terraform with remote state; Checkov in CI blocks insecure changes.
steps: Dev and prod from the same code
goal: Reproducible infra with guardrails before deploy.
deliv: Terraform repo; a PR blocked by Checkov.
value: IaC is in nearly every DevOps posting.

name: Monitoring
arch: Structured logs + metrics + one alert (CloudWatch or Prometheus/Grafana), triggered on purpose.
steps: Inject a failure and find it from telemetry
goal: Know when it breaks before users do.
value: Closes the ops loop interviewers ask about.

name: Kubernetes
arch: kind or k3s locally; RBAC per namespace, Pod Security 'restricted', default-deny NetworkPolicies, Kyverno, Falco.
steps: Deploy the app with Helm or Kustomize
value: Opens K8s-heavy roles; first thing to drop otherwise.

name: Cloud security baseline + detection
arch: On top of PS-3/PS-4: CloudTrail to a locked bucket, Config, Security Hub (CIS), GuardDuty → EventBridge → alerts; 5 detections; leaked-key playbook.
steps: One review by someone more experienced
goal: Detect within minutes; contain with a written procedure.
deliv: Detection repo with tests, runbook, postmortem, CIS before/after.
value: The bridge from DevSecOps to cloud security / SecOps roles.

name: DEBI capstone
arch: PS-7 grown into a full detection lab, or a small posture scanner (Python + boto3). Subject to DEBI approval.
goal: One app, three uses: NTI capstone, DEBI project, CV (doc 19 §C).
value: Turns a program requirement into portfolio evidence.
